title: Turkish Manti (Stuffed Dumplings)
description: A traditional Turkish dish of steamed dumplings filled with spiced meat, served with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of paprika. Enjoy as a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground meat, chopped onion, and spices. Mix well.
Knead the flour and water to form a dough. Divide into small balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle. Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape. Press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Place the dumplings in a steamer basket, leaving some space between each one.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the manti hot with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of paprika. Garnish with Turkish delight, if desired.
